connector.registryDescription: China A-Share quantitative data: 5000+ stocks, 13 factors, daily market & limit-up analysis.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.quant.metrichub.app over server sent events, also runs locally from the Python package mh-fin-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clk1st account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
